w3-m1-identity-authentication-authorizat.prompt: Phát biểu nào mô tả đúng nhất Identity: Authentication, Authorization & OIDC Map?

w3-m1-identity-authentication-authorizat.answer: Authentication proves identity; authorization is an independent Backend policy decision for a specific action/resource.
w3-m1-identity-authentication-authorizat.explanation: Authentication establishes a subject identity. Authorization evaluates whether that subject may perform an action on a resource. OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization; OpenID Connect layers identity tokens and standardized claims over OAuth 2.0. A resource server validates access tokens and makes its own policy decision.
